rows.grounds: compound adhikāra-vihīna with genitive plural ending ānām
compound adhikāra-yuta with instrumental singular ending ena

items.question: Why must mantras be transmitted by an authority-endowed person to those lacking authority?
premises: Those devoid of authority cannot attain mantra siddhi on their own.
Mantras given otherwise would be destroyed in their siddhi.
Therefore transmission requires an authority-endowed person.
items.inference: Mantra efficacy depends on authorized transmission.
uncertainties: The exact scope of adhikāra in this context is not specified.
items.plain_english: Indeed, for those lacking authority, [mantras are given] by one endowed with authority.
